review_type: clean independent original-source / exact asked scope / procedural coverage stopping review
scope: Original 2017 WizKids booklet (all ten pages), all nine original species fronts and Faderan reverse, accepted original printed phase/relic imagery and its allowed provenance, and contemporaneous direct designer official clarifications. Remastered, expansions, optional rules, module behavior, unsupported hypothetical rules and ordinary per-card quantity memorization excluded.

independence.substantive_evidence: Only the four assigned current-bank files, source-manifest, original authorities and explicitly allowed provenance. Runtime/tool availability checks and temporary PDF rendering supplied no substantive game evidence.

source_key_findings.finding: The key turns the token bundled with Envoys output into a prerequisite that its recipient already possess an envoy token. The original sheet does not impose that eligibility restriction. Its first Envoys paragraph says the resources must go to the same player along with an envoy token.

source.section: Envoys, first sentence; also complete 2017 nine-sheet corroborating photo

source_key_findings.source_text: The “Envoys” factory produces many resources, which must be traded or gifted to the same player along with an envoy token.
source_key_findings.current_key: The single recipient of Envoys factory output must have an envoy token; a player without one is ineligible.
source_key_findings.necessary_correction: A player need not already hold an envoy token to receive the output. The entire output goes to one player together with an envoy token. Keep the existing question; answer its eligibility clause accurately.
source_key_findings.replacement_expected_answer: A player without an envoy token is eligible; the recipient need not already hold one. Zeth sends an envoy token together with the complete output.

replacement_required_facts.fact: The recipient need not already hold an envoy token; a player currently without one may receive the complete output.

replacement_contextual_background: An envoy token must accompany the resources to that same recipient. This accompaniment is a separate procedure, not an additional omission gate for the eligibility-only wording.
other_locations_to_reconcile: current-coverage-map.json factory-recipient-eligibility units and Q77 novelty
source_key_findings.related_wording: Q49 expected_answer says “to one player with envoy token.” Its required facts and explicit contextual accompaniment are correct, but change that shorthand to “to one player together with an envoy token” while correcting Q77 so it cannot perpetuate the same preexisting-eligibility interpretation.

exact_asked_scope_findings.finding: Q78 directly asks whether Zeth may trade a spare stash token. “As distinct from gifting” identifies the action under inquiry; it does not separately ask whether gifting is legal. A fully supported affirmative answer to trading resolves the requested permission without independently reciting the gift prohibition. The latter is already directly asked by Q49.
exact_asked_scope_findings.question_text: May Zeth trade a spare envoy token from its stash to another player during Trade, as distinct from gifting that spare token?
exact_asked_scope_findings.necessary_correction: Move Q78.F02 to contextual_background in answer-key.json and asked-facts.json. Do not expand the question merely to retain this extra gate. Q78.F01 remains required; Q49.F03 retains actual coverage of the gifting prohibition.
exact_asked_scope_findings.source_truth_of_removed_gate: Correct source context: Zeth may trade, not gift, stash envoy tokens.
exact_asked_scope_findings.coverage_effect: No source coverage is lost: Q49.F03 directly tests the negative gift permission; Q78.F01 directly tests the positive trade permission.

coverage_stopping_findings.source_unit: Zeth Envoys output must be delivered together with an envoy token to the same recipient
coverage_stopping_findings.finding: Mandatory token accompaniment is currently only Q49 contextual_background. Q49 asks grouping/refusal/stash gifting/onward circulation. Q77 asks recipient eligibility and currently misreads this procedure as preexisting token eligibility. Q78 asks separate stash trading. No actual asked clause correctly tests whether an envoy token must accompany factory output. This token distribution changes future theft-input eligibility and is a consequential procedure, not an ordinary per-card quantity or a cosmetic physical recital.
coverage_stopping_findings.map_change: Remove the unsupported “recipient must already have a token” eligibility coverage. Distinguish same-recipient grouping from mandatory token accompaniment. Give accompaniment coverage only to an actual question that asks it.

proposed_new_question.question: When Zeth trades or gifts the complete output of its Envoys factory to one player, must an envoy token accompany those resources to that same player?
proposed_new_question.expected_answer: Yes. An envoy token must go to that same recipient along with the entire factory output.

required_facts.fact: An envoy token must accompany the complete Envoys factory output to its single recipient.

contextual_background: This distributes a token with factory output; it does not require the recipient to have held one beforehand.
source_references: Original Zeth front, Envoys first sentence
proposed_new_question.novelty: Mandatory factory-triggered envoy-token distribution; distinct from output grouping, prior holdings, stash trade/gift permissions, and later theft discounts.

stopping_assessment.independent_challenge_result: Not justified yet. One consequential original source procedure remains contextual rather than actually asked, and the related new eligibility key is false. Correct Q77 and Q78 scope, actually test mandatory Envoys-token accompaniment, then rewalk current asked clauses. No target N or quota was used.
cosmetic_expansions_rejected: Different failed-promise counts: Q02/Q24 already exercise tariff branches.
Different scoring amounts or a standalone all-groups recital: Q10/Q55 apply the formula to multiple groups.
Different Eni gray/ordinary color: Q12/Q35/Q52 exercise matching/passthrough/all-gray branches.
Another Zeth-versus-Unity wild-input mixture: booklet p7 expressly gives both the same nonmatching-color rule; Q18 already exercises it.
Another Transmutive Decomposer/Economy-chaining example: Q06 governing rule and Q43 point-specific boundary already asked.
Other plain relic entry/output quantities, large rather than small Cache cubes, different Kjas splits, and physical Safe/Vulnerable marker narration.
Optional variants, unsupported final-envoy-token rules, later editions and expansion procedures.
